items.q: Which force is strongest between ethanol molecules?
items.qAf: Watter krag is die sterkste tussen etanolmolekule?
items.explain: Ethanol has an –OH group, so it forms hydrogen bonds.
items.explainAf: Etanol het ’n –OH-groep, dus vorm dit waterstofbindings.

items.q: Ethanol (C₂H₅OH) has a much higher boiling point than ethane (C₂H₆) of similar mass. This is mainly because ethanol:
items.qAf: Etanol (C₂H₅OH) het ’n baie hoër kookpunt as etaan (C₂H₆) van soortgelyke massa. Dit is hoofsaaklik omdat etanol:
items.explain: Hydrogen bonds are much stronger than London forces, so more energy is needed to boil ethanol.
items.explainAf: Waterstofbindings is baie sterker as Londonkragte, dus is meer energie nodig om etanol te laat kook.

items.q: Which substance dissolves best in water?
items.qAf: Watter stof los die beste in water op?
items.explain: Ethanol is polar and forms hydrogen bonds with water, so it mixes well with water.
items.explainAf: Etanol is polêr en vorm waterstofbindings met water, dus meng dit goed met water.

items.q: Which molecule has the highest boiling point?
items.qAf: Watter molekule het die hoogste kookpunt?
items.explain: Methanol has hydrogen bonding, the strongest force among these.
items.explainAf: Metanol het waterstofbinding, die sterkste krag onder hierdie.

items.q: Increasing the chain length of a homologous series of alkanes:
items.qAf: Om die kettinglengte van ’n homoloë reeks alkane te verhoog:
items.explain: Longer chains have larger London forces, raising the boiling point.
items.explainAf: Langer kettings het groter Londonkragte, wat die kookpunt verhoog.

items.q: Why does ice float on water?
options: Hydrogen bonds hold molecules in an open lattice that is less dense
optionsAf: Waterstofbindings hou molekule in ’n oop rooster wat minder dig is
items.explain: In ice the hydrogen-bonded lattice is open, so it is less dense than liquid water.
items.explainAf: In ys is die waterstofgebinde rooster oop, dus is dit minder dig as vloeibare water.

items.q: The pressure exerted by a vapour in equilibrium with its liquid in a closed container.
items.qAf: Die druk wat ’n damp in ewewig met sy vloeistof in ’n geslote houer uitoefen.

items.q: A molecule with a positive end and a negative end.
items.qAf: ’n Molekule met ’n positiewe kant en ’n negatiewe kant.

items.q: The temperature at which the vapour pressure of a liquid equals atmospheric pressure.
items.qAf: Die temperatuur waarby die dampdruk van ’n vloeistof gelyk is aan atmosferiese druk.

items.q: The shape of a CO₂ molecule.

items.text: CO₂ has polar bonds but is a [[]] molecule because its shape is [[]].
items.textAf: CO₂ het polêre bindings maar is ’n [[]] molekule omdat sy vorm [[]] is.

items.q: The shape of a water molecule is angular (bent).
items.qAf: Die vorm van ’n watermolekule is hoekig (gebuig).
items.explain: True. Two lone pairs on oxygen push the bonds into a bent shape.
items.explainAf: Waar. Twee alleenpare op suurstof stoot die bindings in ’n gebuigde vorm.

items.q: A liquid with strong intermolecular forces evaporates quickly.
items.qAf: ’n Vloeistof met sterk intermolekulêre kragte verdamp vinnig.
items.explain: False. Strong forces hold the molecules together, so it evaporates slowly.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Sterk kragte hou die molekules bymekaar, dus verdamp dit stadig.

items.qAf: Pas elke molekule in kolom A by sy vorm in kolom B.
